personality_one_liner: An authoritative, clean, and frictionless career platform where candidates craft tailored AI resumes and recruiters instantly triage top talent.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical padding, clear grouping, touch targets >= 44x44pt, safe area adhered everywhere.

do's: Use frosted glass on sticky headers and bottom tab bars
Apply translucent tinted base for foreground readability
dont's: Never blur form inputs or body text regions
Avoid stacking multiple blur layers over dense content

screens.name: RoleSelection
screens.purpose: Allow the user to choose between Candidate and Recruiter roles immediately upon launch.

states.loading: Centered spinner over warm clean background
states.empty: Role cards loaded with clear descriptive imagery and action buttons
states.error: Readable alert message with retry button

screens.layout: Full-bleed atmospheric background with glass-morphic role selection cards in the lower half, thumb-optimized tap targets.

screens.name: Auth
screens.purpose: Email and password authentication supporting both login and signup flows with role preservation.

states.loading: Activity indicator inside primary CTA button
states.empty: Clean input fields with placeholder labels above inputs
states.error: Inline validation banner with error red styling and retry action

screens.layout: Centered form container inside KeyboardAvoidingView, sticky primary CTA, clean typography.

screens.name: CandidateHome
screens.purpose: Browse open job listings with real-time match percentage and quick apply triggers.

states.loading: Skeleton loader cards matching job card dimensions
states.empty: Illustration, friendly message, and button to reset filters
states.error: Error card with readable message and retry button

screens.layout: Scrollable feed with sticky search header, horizontal category chips, and 100-percent width job cards featuring match score badges.

screens.name: JobDetail
screens.purpose: Examine job details, essential requirements, nice-to-haves, and trigger AI resume customization.

states.empty: No details available message with refresh button
states.error: Error state view with retry action

screens.layout: Hero banner with company logo PNG, sticky header, tabbed description/requirements layout, and persistent sticky bottom apply CTA.

screens.name: CandidateProfile
screens.purpose: Manage personal info, summary, experience, education, skills, portfolio, and professional preferences.

states.empty: Prompt to add professional data to unlock AI resume matching

screens.layout: Sectioned card layout with avatar header, collapsible experience/education lists, and editable profile fields.

screens.name: RecruiterDashboard
screens.purpose: Recruiter command center listing posted jobs and aggregated candidate ranking analytics.

states.loading: Dashboard skeleton loader with pulse effect
states.empty: Illustration with prompt to create the first job posting

screens.layout: Top stats overview followed by active job cards and candidate breakdown lists sorted by mandatory requirements match.

screens.name: JobCreation
screens.purpose: Publish new job listings specifying title, company, location, modality, description, mandatory requirements, and nice-to-haves.

states.error: Validation error highlight on missing mandatory fields

screens.layout: Single-column scrollable form with structured tag inputs for mandatory requirements and differentiators, sticky submit CTA at bottom.

candidate_hero.alt: Professionals collaborating in a modern workspace

recruiter_hero.alt: Recruiter analyzing candidate profiles on screen

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all screens adhere strictly to the 1 iOS-Native Clean personality guidelines. Use Plus Jakarta Sans typography with font weight capped at 500. Implement sticky bottom CTAs on forms and detail screens. Every branded entity must fetch real PNG logos. Include full Loading, Empty, and Error states on every data screen. Apply safe-area margins and ensure touch targets are at least 44x44pt.
